questions.q: What is the defining characteristic of SQL Server enabled by Azure Arc?
options: It registers an existing SQL Server instance, anywhere outside Azure, into Azure's control plane — the database itself never moves
It automatically migrates the on-prem database into Azure SQL Database
It requires converting the instance to run inside a Kubernetes cluster
It only works for SQL Server instances already running in Azure
questions.explain: Arc is a management and licensing layer over an instance that stays exactly where it is — a Connected Machine agent and extension connect it to Azure over outbound HTTPS only.

questions.q: Which of these is a real capability you get from registering a SQL Server instance with Azure Arc?
options: A unified inventory across every registered SQL Server, queryable with Azure Resource Graph, plus best-practices assessment
Automatic conversion of the instance to Azure SQL Managed Instance
Unlimited free compute for the instance
Removal of all licensing requirements
questions.explain: Arc gives you a single point of control: cross-instance inventory queries, best-practices assessment, Defender for Cloud, Entra ID authentication, and Extended Security Updates billed through Azure.

questions.q: What is SQL database in Microsoft Fabric?
options: A generally available OLTP database that runs on the same SQL Database Engine as Azure SQL Database, but is provisioned inside a Fabric workspace
A read-only reporting copy of an existing Azure SQL Database
A NoSQL document database exclusive to Microsoft Fabric
A deprecated preview feature no longer supported
questions.explain: It reached general availability at Microsoft Ignite in November 2025 and uses the same engine as Azure SQL Database, but lives inside a Fabric workspace rather than as a standalone Azure resource.

questions.q: What does a SQL database in Microsoft Fabric do automatically that a standalone Azure SQL Database does not?
options: It automatically mirrors every write into OneLake in near real time, in an analytics-ready format, with no separate ETL pipeline required
It automatically deletes data older than 30 days
It automatically converts all tables to NoSQL collections
It automatically disables all T-SQL querying
questions.explain: The near-real-time mirroring into OneLake, converted to Delta/Parquet, is what makes the same transactional data instantly usable by Spark, Power BI, and other Fabric analytics tools without building a pipeline.
